question: In which state was the 7th Khelo India Youth Games held in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bihar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **7th Khelo India Youth Games** in **2025** were held in the state of **Bihar**, marking a significant event for promoting sports and athletic development in the region.
 
• The Khelo India initiative aims to encourage participation in sports among youth and foster a culture of fitness and physical activity across the country.
 
• The choice of **Bihar** as the host state highlights the government’s focus on expanding sports facilities and opportunities in eastern India.
 
• The event was organized by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, which collaborates with state governments to host the games effectively. *Hence, Bihar was the correct answer.*
 
• The **Khelo India Youth Games** provide a platform for young athletes to showcase their talent and receive support to excel at national and international levels.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About Khelo India Youth Games:**

 
 
• The **Khelo India** programme was launched in **2018** to promote sports at the grassroots level and identify young talent for advanced training.
 
• The Youth Games focus on athletes under the age of **17 years** and provide them with exposure to competitive sports.
 
• Previous host states for the games have included **Maharashtra, Haryana, Karnataka**, and **Madhya Pradesh**, showcasing the initiative's reach across India.
 
 
 
• **Sports in Bihar:**
 
 
• Bihar has been working to improve its sports infrastructure to encourage local talent and boost sports culture in the state.
 
• Hosting events like the **Khelo India Youth Games** provides an opportunity to showcase Bihar’s advancements in sports facilities.
 
 
 
• **Impact of Khelo India:**
 
 
• The initiative has successfully fostered a sports culture in India, with thousands of athletes benefiting from scholarships and training programs.
 
• It has also helped in improving sports infrastructure in various states, making sports accessible to youth across the country.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Key Features of Khelo India:**

 
 
• The programme includes initiatives like **scholarship schemes**, **talent identification**, and **sports infrastructure development**.
 
• It emphasizes increasing participation in sports and nurturing future stars for **Olympic-level competitions**.
 
 
 
• **Significant Developments:**
 
 
• **Maharashtra** hosted the inaugural edition of the games in **2018**, setting the stage for subsequent events.
 
• **Haryana** hosted the games in **2021**, showcasing its strong sports culture and infrastructure.
 
• The 7th edition in **Bihar** demonstrated the government's efforts to promote sports in less-represented regions.
